brief: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching.

requirements.evidence: Spike is present at junction [0,0],[0,1],[1,0] on piece:0,0,0;half-n, but drawer cannot be added to that same corner - apply with both returns SPIKE_CLASH. Requirement for both at same corner touching is prohibited by configurator collision rule, so not met together.

finish.summary: Build has 3 bases forming one three-way junction with a spike at that junction. The requested co-location of drawer and spike at the identical corner is refused by the configurator with SPIKE_CLASH - only one can occupy that junction. The build demonstrates the requested position exists, but the rule prevents both being there at once, so the combined requirement is unmet.
